target.purpose: deployment and acceptance rehearsal, never production service

service_units.purpose: three-node HA topology and application-service rehearsal

hard_rejections: target identity or host set differs from the declared sandbox
two addresses resolve to the same machine identity
host OS or architecture is heterogeneous
clock is not synchronized or timezone is not UTC
minimum CPU, memory, or free-space floor is missed
PostgreSQL initialization contract differs across members
inventory and live PostgreSQL or Patroni roles disagree
a production SLO is claimed from the sandbox topology
unredacted secret values appear in exported evidence

accepted_sandbox_exceptions.reason: all four VMs share one physical laptop, power source, hypervisor, and storage substrate
accepted_sandbox_exceptions.production_impact: node count does not prove independent failure domains

accepted_sandbox_exceptions.reason: the teaching sandbox has one etcd member
accepted_sandbox_exceptions.production_impact: DCS availability is not production representative

accepted_sandbox_exceptions.reason: the teaching sandbox uses one local MinIO/control node
accepted_sandbox_exceptions.production_impact: backup repository failure-domain and disaster recovery are not proven

accepted_sandbox_exceptions.reason: Vagrant virtual disks have no production IOPS, latency, endurance, or redundancy qualification
accepted_sandbox_exceptions.production_impact: capacity and durability conclusions are prohibited

accepted_sandbox_exceptions.reason: randomized sandbox secrets are stored in a mode-0600 temporary inventory
accepted_sandbox_exceptions.production_impact: a production secret authority, rotation, and audit path remain required

accepted_sandbox_exceptions.reason: the three pg-test VMs have one vCPU and about 1.9 GiB RAM, below the chapter recommendation of two vCPUs and 2 GiB
accepted_sandbox_exceptions.production_impact: the successful deployment proves only the disposable sandbox acceptance floor; it cannot justify production sizing or concurrency claims

gate_interpretation.sandbox_l2: may pass with the six named exceptions
gate_interpretation.ch19_deployment_baseline: remains pending for a real pg-ha-standard production target
